column1: # rlx gpu dispatch tuning cache v2
# Shipped per-hardware tuning: measured winners loaded BELOW the user cache
# (`RLX_GPU_TUNING_CACHE`), so a local re-tune of the same key always wins.
# Every row must carry its evidence (speedup, holdouts >= 1) — see shipped.rs.
# Disable at runtime with RLX_GPU_NO_SHIPPED_TUNING=1.
# arch
# wgpu over Metal, Apple M4 Pro (20-core GPU), 2026-10-24:
# `cargo run --release -p rlx-wgpu --example wgpu_tune_dispatch` — default and candidate
# interleaved per sample, median per-sample ratio, default-vs-default control
# 0.97-1.01x. Decode GEMV (m=1): the vec4 F32 kernel vs the CoopF32 default, which
# pads m=1 to a 32-row cooperative tile (31/32 of its MACs discarded). Holdouts:
# Second clean run (controls 0.97-1.01x) re-confirmed those and added the fused
# QKV / gate-up bucket 0.10.12 (holdouts 2.18x/2.35x) and the vocab head 0.10.17
# (holdouts 1.82x/1.83x) — together ~3/4 of Qwen3-0.6B's per-token GEMV bytes.
